_note: New actor, first pricing entry. PAY_PER_EVENT, two tiers: a posting opened for its full description and salary costs a detail call, a listing-only row does not. Rivals charge $0.001-0.002 per job; this one also resolves company names, searches across the whole directory and reads past Workday's 2,000 cap. No per-run free allowance: buyers schedule it with onlyNew. A run with no jobs is free. No proxy.

job_row.eventDescription: One open job from a Workday career site with company, title, requisition ID, location, country, remote flag, posted age, full description, salary range where the posting states one, and apply link. A run that returns no jobs is free.

job_row_basic.eventDescription: One open job from the career site's listing only (Full description off, or the posting could not be opened): company, title, requisition ID, location, posted age and apply link, without description or salary.
